# Getting help

- **Questions and bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/mralaminahamed/sitemon/issues/new/choose) using the bug report or feature request form. The repository has no Discussions.
- **Security problems:** do not open an issue. Follow the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).
- **Contributing:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Setup, configuration and usage are covered in the [README](../README.md) and the [docs](../docs/README.md).
